name: @tale/controller
description: Tale controller — privileged control-plane sidecar that restarts allowlisted compose services on HMAC-signed request

scripts.dev: if [ -z "$CONTROLLER_TOKEN" ]; then echo '[controller] CONTROLLER_TOKEN unset — skipping opt-in sidecar in dev (set it in .env to run locally).'; exit 0; fi; bun --hot src/server.ts
